changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Resource_UID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Resource_UID] ON [dbo].[Resource] ( [UID] ASC) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Resource_APIPublicKey_APIPrivateKey') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Resource_APIPublicKey_APIPrivateKey] ON [dbo].[Resource] ( [APIPublicKey] ASC,[APIPrivateKey] ASC) END
changeSet.rollback:
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Resource_UID') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Resource_UID] ON [dbo].[Resource] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Resource_APIPublicKey_APIPrivateKey') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Resource_APIPublicKey_APIPrivateKey] ON [dbo].[Resource] END
